items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 102:1
items.html: (To the question) For at the time that ZA has Mochin of SAG, Leah is then corrected like the great Nukva in the body of ZA; therefore her Mochin are found equal to the Nukva of ZA in his body, namely the aspect of the concealed Hassadim of the GAR of Bina. Hence Leah is then counted as though she is attached to him, for her Mochin are equal to his. However, at the time that she receives the Mochin of the AB of the Ima of the Mazal, which are the Mochin of the separation, then Leah joins with Rachel, who is from the chest and below, and is made into a single Partzuf; and her Mochin are found in the aspect of revealed Hassadim, which are different from ZA. Therefore she is now discerned as having been sawed apart from ZA. And see above, Answer 222. (Items 120 and 125).
